episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Kevin, a newly retired police officer, faces tougher challenges at home than he ever did on the streets. In the opener, Kevin's retirement plans go awry when he learns his wife has shielded him from key family problems while he worked as a cop and that he must now face them head-on.

episodes.title: Sleep Disorder
episodes.summary: Kevin rearranges the house to his liking after his buddies convince him that Donna makes all their decisions and has organized the house for her own benefit. Meanwhile, Kendra enlists her Uncle Kyle to help toughen up Chale.

episodes.title: Chore Weasel
episodes.summary: Kevin thinks he's got it made when he hires someone, via a new online app, to do household chores for him while he plays football with his buddies and then takes all the credit with Donna.

episodes.title: Kevin and Donna's Book Club
episodes.summary: After Kevin witnesses Donna and her friends' raucous laughter during their book club gathering, he tries to spice up his own social life by evaluating how each of his buddies could be more fun.

episodes.title: Kevin's Good Story
episodes.summary: Kevin forgets his wedding anniversary and tries to use Goody's heroic cop story to bail himself out.

episodes.title: Beat the Parents
episodes.summary: Kevin and Donna try to sabotage their son's friendship with a boy from school after meeting the kid's arrogant father and pushy mom.

episodes.title: Hallow-We-Ain't-Home
episodes.summary: On Halloween, Kevin and Donna's neighbors "trick" them in holiday style when they pretend not to be home to avoid giving out candy. Also, Chale has an altercation with a man dressed as a Viking.

episodes.title: Who's Better Than Us?
episodes.summary: Kevin gets jealous when he hears how happy his former patrol partner is with the extremely well fit rookie now riding with him and sets out to show his old friend what he's missing.

episodes.title: The Power of Positive Drinking
episodes.summary: When Kevin takes a job as a bartender, he goes too far when he starts dispensing unsolicited advice to his customers.

episodes.title: The Fantastic Pho
episodes.summary: A newly retired police officer realizes taking care of his family is a job in its own right.

episodes.title: Kevin's Bringing Supper Back
episodes.summary: Kevin's resolve to spend more quality time with his family is put to the ultimate test when his buddies surprise him with concert tickets to his favorite musician, fellow Long Islander Billy Joel.

episodes.title: I'll Be Home for Christmas... Maybe
episodes.summary: Kevin volunteers to help Mott and his seven kids prepare for the holidays while Mott's wife is away, much to the dismay of Donna who is left high and dry on her own until Kyle swoops in to help.

episodes.title: Ring Worm
episodes.summary: After Kevin learns Chale took a job to buy Kendra an engagement ring, he decides to make good on his overdue promise to buy Donna a proper ring, but his plan backfires when he tries to surprise her.

episodes.title: Kevin vs. the Dutch Elm
episodes.summary: While Kevin tries to charm his elderly neighbor into giving him permission to cut down one of her trees, he gets intimidated by her son and inadvertently invites them to his house for a non-existent party.

episodes.title: Choke Doubt
episodes.summary: Kevin brags about saving a man from choking after hearing how much attention his brother Kyle is receiving for saving a cat.

episodes.title: The Back Out
episodes.summary: When he catches them "cheating" on him with his colleague. Also, Kyle, still bitter that Kevin overlooked him to be best man at his wedding to Donna, tries to convince Chale to give him that responsibility.

episodes.title: Unholy War
episodes.summary: Approval by becoming more involved in the church, Kevin's drive to get the church for Kendra becomes an insatiable desire to get revenge on his old rival.

episodes.title: Neighborhood Watch
episodes.summary: Kevin concocts an elaborate plan to get out of having to spend time with Donna's cousin Irene and her chatty husband.

episodes.title: Showroom Showdown
episodes.summary: When Kevin and Chale get jobs working in the warehouse at an electronics store to help pay for the wedding, Chale's quick promotion to the sales floor kick-starts Kevin's competitive side.

episodes.title: Double Date
episodes.summary: Invite the Motts on a weekend getaway with them, Kevin and Donna are offended by the friendship demotion and go online to find new couples to hang out with.

episodes.title: Kenny Can Wait
episodes.summary: Kevin strikes up an unlikely friendship with Harry Connick Jr., but gets caught in a web of lies trying to impress his new friend.

episodes.title: Quiet Diet
episodes.summary: When Donna says she'll send Kevin to the Mets Fantasy Camp if he lowers his cholesterol, Chale secretly coaches Kevin through a juice cleanse.

episodes.title: Sting of Queens: Part One
episodes.summary: Kevin begrudgingly agrees to come out of retirement briefly to reprise an undercover assignment where he and his old rival, Vanessa Cellucci, once again, pose as husband and wife. Also, Donna is up for a promotion, Kendra gets accepted to law school, and Chale gets a lucrative new job.

episodes.title: Sting of Queens: Part Two
episodes.summary: Kevin is strong-armed by his undercover partner, Vanessa, to extend their investigation by attending a fraudulent dealer's weekend art show in Boston, causing him to miss Mets Fantasy Camp with his buddies. Also, Chale's dream job is not what it seems, and Donna mouths off to her boss.

episodes.title: Civil Ceremony
episodes.summary: To officiate the ceremony, Vanessa helps Kendra put together the last-minute affair.

episodes.title: Business Unusual
episodes.summary: Overwhelmed by Kevin's helicopter parenting, Kendra tricks him into taking a job at Vanessa's new private security company.

episodes.title: Kevin Goes Nuts
episodes.summary: After Vanessa suggests that Sara has a secret boyfriend, Kevin goes undercover to find out the truth. Also, Jack desperately searches for an illness he can claim as his own after the "cool" kids with peanut allergies learn he's been lying about sharing their malady.

episodes.title: Plus One Is the Loneliest Number
episodes.summary: After Vanessa's relationship with a hunky doctor goes bust before her sister's wedding, Kevin steps in as her 'successful doctor' date. Also, Kyle helps Kendra and Chale make a fake photo collage of honeymoon pictures to tout on social media

episodes.title: Grief Thief
episodes.summary: Vanessa plots her revenge on Kevin after learning he lied his way out of working on a Sunday to attend a football game with Goody. Also, Kyle has a new girlfriend, Denise, and Chale and Kendra have their first squabble as a married couple.

episodes.title: The Owl
episodes.summary: Kevin and Chale set out on a road trip to retrieve an owl-shaped cookie jar that Kevin sold before realizing how much it meant to Kendra. Also, after Vanessa rejects Kyle's attempt to woo her, she and Kendra help get him back on the dating scene.

episodes.title: The Kevin Crown Affair
episodes.summary: When Kevin and Vanessa try to land a security gig at a toy store, they get sidetracked practicing their new business pitch and wind up locked in the store after hours. Also, Chale is having success working at Enzo's.

episodes.title: Slip ‘n' Fall
episodes.summary: Kevin and Vanessa concoct a plan when they fear Rootger might sue them after he slips and injures himself at their office. Also, Kendra dispenses legal advice at Enzo's for paying customers.

episodes.title: Cooking Up a Storm
episodes.summary: After Kevin insists he can handle cooking a full Thanksgiving dinner for Vanessa and his family, he realizes he's in over his head and secretly asks his flirtatious neighbor, Wendy, for help.

episodes.title: Kevin Moves Metal
episodes.summary: As part of a security job, Kevin goes undercover as a janitor at a car dealership, but he accidentally sells a car to a customer and finds himself on track to win top salesman of the month. Also, Chale reveals his phobia of puppets after learning that Kendra used to be into ventriloquism.

episodes.title: Trainer Wreck
episodes.summary: After Vanessa asks Kevin to help her get a date with a handsome personal trainer, Alejandro, she gets frustrated when Kevin starts training with him instead. Also, Chale reluctantly takes advice from Kyle when the health inspector stops by Enzo's.

episodes.title: The Might've Before Christmas
episodes.summary: While Vanessa and the Gable family gather around the Christmas tree, Vanessa and Kevin reminisce about their first patrol together.

episodes.title: Monkey Fist Insecurity
episodes.summary: After Kevin and Vanessa nail a pitch for a new job for their security company, Monkey Fist, they run into Frank, the owner of a rival company who is determined to put them out of business by pitting Kevin and Vanessa against each other.

episodes.title: Kevin Can Date
episodes.summary: Vanessa encourages Kevin to ask out a client, Rebecca, after she shows interest in him.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.summary: On a flight for a security job, Vanessa tells a flight attendant that she and Kevin are newly married in order to get bumped up to first class, but her fib creates a lot of extra baggage when Kevin meets Lisa and the two hit it off

episodes.title: 40 Under 40
episodes.summary: When Vanessa is featured in a local magazine article about entrepreneurs under 40 years old, a jealous Kevin tries to get attention for himself by securing his own award, while reminding her that she is over 40. Also, Chale fixes up Kyle on a date with his wild Aunt Kristin.

episodes.title: Wingmen
episodes.summary: After Kevin and Vanessa witness Kyle's success using a dating app that requires a close friend to choose one's perfect match, they agree to be each other's wingman and try their hand at matchmaking.

episodes.title: The Whole Enchilada
episodes.summary: After convincing Kevin to break things off with his neighbor, Wendy, who had reeled him in with her delicious meals, Vanessa feels compelled to cook for him despite being culinarily challenged.

episodes.title: Delivery Guy
episodes.summary: Vanessa convinces Kevin to go on a TV talk show with the "baby boy" he helped deliver years ago as a cop, but her plan to promote Monkey Fist backfires when Kevin runs into his arch-nemesis, Frank Munson.

episodes.title: Forty Seven Candles
episodes.summary: Vanessa thinks she's friendless when none of her pals are available to go to dinner with her on her birthday. Feeling lonely while waiting for Kevin to pick her up for what she thinks is just a dinner for two, Vanessa gets tipsy with Kyle, and the two share a flirtatious moment.

episodes.title: The Smoking Bun
episodes.summary: Plans to knock down Enzo's and build a parking lot cause problems for the guys. But when Alviti makes them a lucrative job offer, the future of Enzo's is at stake.

episodes.title: Phat Monkey
episodes.summary: When Monkey Fist lands Alviti's big account to provide security for his parking garages, Kevin inadvertently derails Rootger's efforts to study for his security guard test and puts the new job in jeopardy, much to Vanessa's dismay. Also, Kendra and Chale try to persuade an investor to help finance their brew pub idea.

episodes.title: Brew Ha Ha
episodes.summary: Kevin offers to help Kendra and Chale buy Enzo's, but they soon realize that the partnership won't work when Kevin's idea of a silent partner is not so silent. As the tension among them escalates, Kendra and Chale find peace at Vanessa's apartment.

episodes.title: A Band Done
episodes.summary: After a former bandmate talks Kevin into reuniting with their old band, Smokefish, with hopes of making it big, Vanessa realizes a chance encounter with the band in her past changed the course of her life.
